title: A Clock for the Typewriter
author: Zephyrine Thackeray
blurb: Dominic Montrose, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
